summary.text: Reggie Hall is the Republican candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 87, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Karen Camper.
Ballotpedia lists him as a small business owner and a native of Memphis.

paragraphs.text: Reggie Hall was born in Memphis, Tennessee, and graduated from Hamilton High School.
His professional experience includes working as a small business owner.
In 2023 he was a candidate for Mayor of Memphis, a nonpartisan race that Paul Young won.

In a 2023 Ballotpedia survey for that race, he described himself as a resident of South Memphis with a background in mental health, rehabilitation and transportation work, and said education, public safety, blight, infrastructure and poverty were his main issues.
Hall advanced from the Republican primary for District 87 on August 6, 2026.
